Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly identified Jane Monheit as the jazz singer with the 2003 album "The Boy Next Door." This error occurred because the visible portion of the DuckDuckGo search results included conflicting information, with both Jane Monheit and Stacey Kent mentioned in relation to "The Boy Next Door." However, WebSurfer did not investigate further or validate this information by clicking on the links or analyzing the sources in detail. A more thorough examination of the search results (e.g., visiting the Wikipedia and Discogs pages) would have revealed that Stacey Kent, not Jane Monheit, is the correct artist associated with the 2003 album "The Boy Next Door." This oversight led to the Planner concluding the task with the incorrect answer.
